name: SkeletonNode

props.description: Travelling sheen instead of the pulse.

tagline: Square media/custom placeholder (also Skeleton.Node); children centre inside it.
usage: DO use it as the generic square when no other preset matches — a chart slot, a map tile, a QR code.
DON'T put text in it; it is a shape, and its container is already aria-busy.
